card.summary: Lightweight, fast workhorse with the biggest LoRA/ControlNet ecosystem; lower native resolution and weaker prompt adherence than modern models. Its older, grittier look and huge style ecosystem make it a strong pick for heavily stylized art, intentionally low-fi/poor-quality aesthetics, and horror.
use_cases: when a specific SD1.5 LoRA/ControlNet is needed
card.pick_when: Speed/VRAM matters, quick drafts, or a specific SD1.5 asset is required.

prompt.guidance: Plain English or loose comma keywords; 77-token chunks.
prompt.example: a photograph of an astronaut riding a horse on mars, highly detailed, dramatic lighting, 50mm photo
prompt.overview: Classic CLIP-era model (512 native): short comma-separated keyword/quality tags plus a negative prompt; English only.
prompt.instructions: Lead with the subject, then append comma-separated descriptor/quality tags (e.g. `detailed, 8k`, color-palette terms). Prompts are short and English-only (CLIP truncates at ~77 tokens). Native resolution 512x512 -- straying far hurts coherence. Guidance scale ~5-8 (diffusers default 7.5). Known weaknesses to prompt around: cannot render legible text, weak spatial composition, imperfect faces -- keep compositional relationships simple. Negative prompts are the standard quality lever.
do: Lead with subject then comma-separated descriptor/quality tags
dont: Write long narrative paragraphs (77-token CLIP limit)
examples: Astronaut in a jungle, cold color palette, muted colors, detailed, 8k
a photo of an astronaut riding a horse on mars, highly detailed, sharp focus
prompt.negative_guidance: High value in practice. Typical: 'lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra digits, blurry, text, watermark, jpeg artifacts'.

negative.note: Helpful. e.g. 'lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, watermark, blurry, worst quality'.

speed.measured_note: ~6s for the first image at default settings (512x512, 28 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe it in plain words. Best at smaller, simpler scenes — one subject works better than a busy scene. Also a strong pick for heavily stylized art, intentionally rough/low-fi looks, and horror or unsettling imagery.
ui_help.good_for: quick simple pictures, heavily stylized art, low-fi/gritty looks, and horror
